pj: Quick sync  planning a "mini-runway" to onboard 3 legacy tenants next sprint. Need micro-bench, pin rules, and a short rollback play.
anna (prod): Agree. Micro-bench = 6 prompts/tenant, p50/p95, token-cost/1k, and a single human smoke. Keep run <90s per model. Fail -> hold canary.
raj (eng-runtime): Tech notes: add streaming toggle; warm KV cache step; embedding-schema check with auto-block. Pin API: /admin/catalog/pin with TTL + audit. Enterprise opt-out for auto-fallback.
pj: Rollout waves: internal QA -> 2 low-traffic tenants -> up to 3 more. Gate = bench pass + 8h observation without error spike.
bench-bot: Canary job queued: mini-onboard-178123 at 2025-11-03T13:00Z (CI: https://ci.redwood/onboard/178123).
